function_text: Functions as an antiviral innate immune response receptor that detects cytoplasmic viral RNA and activates interferon signaling pathways.
Catalyzes the phosphorylation of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine to produce N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate in amino sugar metabolism.
Involved in nuclear import processes and protein transport across the nuclear envelope membrane.
Functions as a membrane protein involved in autophagy and cellular trafficking between organelles.
Essential autophagy-related protein that regulates selective autophagy and cytoplasm-to-vacuole transport pathways.
